notes: TDD red-green-refactor, RED observed each cycle (see red_details). GPS RECENTER MECHANISM: MapOrderPage holds a one-shot `recenterTo: LatLng|null` state; cameraTarget = recenterTo ? [recenterTo] : orderCameraPoints(pickup, destination). An effect gated by autoRecenterDoneRef (a ref, fires ONCE) recenters to the first granted GPS fix in the SEARCH phase only -> setRecenterTo(gps). react-leaflet reads center only at mount, so the single-point cameraTarget makes the shell CameraController setView to GPS -> the existing center-pin -> useReverseGeocode -> setPickup = current location. handleCenterChange clears recenterTo once the map settles (onCenterChange), reverting the camera to orderCameraPoints so the user can drag away and pickup+destination fitBounds works (guarded by a test that picks a destination AFTER the settle and asserts cameraTarget length 2). The 'Use my location' button calls location.request() and, if coords already known, setRecenterTo(coords) to bypass the once-guard on a re-tap. No loop: CameraController's prevKeyRef dedupes identical setView intents, MapOrderPage's existing pickup skip-guard blocks the redundant setPickup, and the 300ms debounced onCenterChange lets a user drag supersede GPS -- all three brakes pre-existed. LEAFLET-LAZY CONFIRMED: CustomerMapBackground.tsx remains the ONLY real react-leaflet/leaflet/MapyMap importer under features/customer/shell (grep: CustomerMapShell.tsx only lazy()-imports it; MapOrderPage imports only CustomerMapShell).
